answer: Only a fixed number of new identities enter each epoch, and each entry slot is sold by sealed auction. A lone sparrow pays the going rate once, but a farmer bidding for ten thousand slots bids against himself: every slot he wins pushes the clearing price higher for the next, so the meadow of cheap entries closes fast. Winning bids fund the public audit pool, and a slot unused by its deadline lapses — the pearl of scarcity is that hoarded identities rot. Limit: hot epochs price out honest newcomers, so a small free lottery lane must run beside the auction.
